Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results and incorrectly claimed that Julia (daughter of Julius Caesar and Cornelia) was married to Tiberius, conflating her with Julia the Elder (daughter of Augustus). This led to the wrong conclusion that Cornelia’s child-in-law was Tiberius. In fact, Julia married Pompey, making Pompey the correct child-in-law. The error was an unsupported inference not evidenced by the WebSurfer’s output and not cross-verified.
